title: JSON schema for groepenkaart v3
description: Group rcdId values must refer to the id of an entry in rcds. When rcdEnabled is false, rcds must be empty. A 2-pole RCD has zero or one phase and a 4-pole RCD has all three phases. Groups linked to a 2-pole RCD use its phase; all other groups use their own phases.

$schema.description: URL of the JSON Schema used to validate this file.

schemaVersion.description: Version of the groepenkaart data format.

rcdEnabled.description: Whether groups can be linked to RCDs (Aardlekschakelaars).

phaseEnabled.description: Whether phase selection and phase display on the groups card are enabled for a three-phase installation.

phases.description: A 2-pole RCD has zero or one selected phase (empty means not chosen). A 4-pole RCD has all three phases.

items.description: Optional list of appliances or connections on this group.

phases.description: The group's own phase selection (empty means not chosen). It is ignored while the group is linked to a 2-pole RCD, which supplies the phase instead, but it is kept so it is available again when the group is unlinked.
